projects.project_about: Production AI-powered contact enrichment platform at Sprouts.ai supporting intelligent provider orchestration, Elasticsearch retrieval, LLM reasoning, entity resolution, workflow automation, distributed processing, authentication, caching, and scalable REST APIs.
projects.project_tool: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, Next.js, Docker, Kubernetes
projects.challenge: Turn fragmented enterprise contact data into searchable, actionable enrichment using LLM reasoning, semantic retrieval, and entity resolution over Elasticsearch—while coordinating multiple providers with async workflows, retries, rate limits, and cost-aware orchestration.
projects.outcome: Shipped two production FastAPI microservices with Azure OpenAI / Hugging Face inference, SQLAlchemy, Redis caching, OAuth2/JWT, multi-tenant RBAC, Alembic, GitHub Actions, and Next.js product surfaces (dashboards, graph discovery, hierarchy views)—improving reliability, maintainability, and infrastructure efficiency.

projects.project_about: Interactive Ask AI on this portfolio so visitors can explore experience, projects, and thesis by text or voice. The privacy-first voice flow is intentionally turn-based: open Ask AI, say Hey Wick or tap the mic, ask one question, then the mic releases while the answer is generated and spoken. A short follow-up window supports natural conversation before the mic turns fully off. Browser speech is selectable across English, ten Indian languages, Spanish, French, and German; typed chat remains available everywhere.
projects.project_tool: React, Vite, Web Speech API, MediaRecorder, speechSynthesis, Cloudflare Workers, Workers AI, Whisper STT, rate limiting
projects.challenge: Ship a real LLM + voice demo on static GitHub Pages without exposing keys; support natural, multilingual interaction while keeping the free Workers AI tier safe and avoiding an always-active microphone.
projects.outcome: Delivered a grounded, turn-based Concierge with browser STT/TTS, Workers AI Whisper fallback for English, Hey Wick after the panel opens, a six-second follow-up window, and no background listening. Added language selection for English, Indian regional languages, Spanish, French, and German; formatted replies; CORS/origin allowlisting; separate chat/STT rate limits; audio caps; and automatic free-quota pause.

projects.project_about: Full-stack blink-tracking wellness system: PyQt6 desktop client with MediaPipe face mesh, FastAPI + JWT backend, offline SQLite sync queue, and a Next.js Chart.js dashboard.
projects.project_tool: Python, FastAPI, PyQt6, MediaPipe, OpenCV, Next.js, SQLAlchemy, JWT, SQLite, PostgreSQL, Docker
projects.challenge: Capture blink metrics on-device, keep working offline, then sync securely to a cloud API and read-only dashboard without storing raw camera frames.
projects.outcome: Shipped a three-tier product (desktop + API + web) with simulated/real tracker modes, JWT auth, per-user data scoping, Dockerized API, pytest coverage, and privacy/security docs.

projects.project_name: Football Video Analysis with Pose + YOLO
projects.project_about: Computer-vision pipeline that combines MediaPipe pose landmarks with YOLOv8 detections to count foot–ball contacts, estimate velocity, infer ball direction, and export an annotated analysis video.
projects.project_tool: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Ultralytics YOLOv8, NumPy
projects.challenge: Turn raw football footage into measurable touch and motion signals without calibrated lab cameras.
projects.outcome: Built a touch-release pipeline that overlays live touch counts, velocity estimates, and optical-flow direction onto an annotated output video (Git LFS for large media).

projects.project_name: UAV Path Loss Prediction using Machine Learning
projects.project_about: Random Forest, ANN, KNN, Naive Bayes, and linear models for UAV air-to-air path loss prediction using terrain, elevation, clutter height, and communication parameters—paired with Okumura–Hata / log-distance baselines. Public research code + paper (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
projects.project_tool: Python, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, TensorFlow, PyTorch
projects.challenge: Improve wireless path-loss prediction accuracy for UAV A2A links beyond classical empirical models alone.
projects.outcome: Feature engineering, visualization, and comparative model evaluation across propagation scenarios; paper and notebook linked from the thesis page.

projects.project_about: Vertical short-video mobile app with Google sign-in, Firebase Storage uploads, Firestore metadata, scroll-based autoplay feed, likes, mute toggle, profiles, and bottom-tab navigation.
projects.project_tool: React Native CLI, Firebase Auth, Firestore, Storage, React Navigation, react-native-video
projects.challenge: Ship a Reels-style client loop—auth, upload, feed playback, and social actions—on React Native with a Firebase backend.
projects.outcome: Implemented Android-ready RN CLI app structure with auth gate, feed/upload/profile screens, and Firebase integration (client configs gitignored).

projects.project_about: PyTorch multilayer perceptron regressing Boston median home values from 13 urban and socio-economic features—ML fundamentals notebook with StandardScaler preprocessing and train/test evaluation (test R² ≈ 0.81).
projects.challenge: Model non-linear relationships between fragmented urban indicators and housing prices.
projects.outcome: Trained a 13→64→32→1 MLP with Adam/MSE; notebook documents loss convergence and R² ≈ 0.81 on held-out data.

projects.project_about: Classifier comparison on the Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer (WDBC) dataset to separate malignant vs benign cases, with notebook exploration and evaluation.
projects.challenge: Evaluate multiple classifiers on a clinical tabular dataset and surface malignant vs benign prediction quality.
projects.outcome: Public notebook + WDBC data demonstrating multi-classifier experimentation for diagnostic classification.

projects.project_about: Scalable distributed database platform for hotel management using Django, PostgreSQL, and Azure SQL supporting secure multi-user operations and efficient data management.
projects.challenge: Support secure multi-user hotel operations with efficient relational data management at scale.
projects.outcome: Optimized relational database performance, backend APIs, and modular system design for scalability and maintainability.
